reviews.title: It's a budget board
reviews.comment:
For the price, this is a really good deal.  It's not the best board on the market but it had the necessary features I needed to make the build.  The board doesn't have any PBO features so if you're looking to over clock or under volt your cpu, this won't work.  i don't typically overclock cpus so it's okay with me.  The board does have two dual channel ram slots, which I filled with 32 gb of ddr5.  The board does allow you to overclock ram.  The board supports AM5 chips.  I coupled this board with a 7700x.  The chip runs great on this board.  Didn't need to under volt or overclock it.  The board automatically restricts the temps and power consumption.  The performance of the cpu seems standard.  It matches most cinebench tests posted online.
The board also comes with 2 nvme ssd ports which I think is great for the price.  However, the board doesn't come with heat spreaders for the NVME sticks.  Overall, it's a good board if you're on a budget.
reviews.author: AmazingPurchases

reviews.title: Doesn't work as advertised.
reviews.comment: I bought this but had life happen before UI could start my build so I couldn't return it to amazon. Doesn't work, never did. Argued with ASROCK over it, they refused to honor their 1 year warranty despite knowing it doesn't work with the AMD Ryzen™ 7 8700F despite it's description. Lights come on, no video output without the processor for some reason so you can't even see bios with no processor. They say you can update the firmware of the motherboard, their instructions do not work. I work in tech, I fix computers, I decided to eat the cost rather than keep working on it. It's a shame because I have used the same brand before for other builds and it works great. This board also did not include the umm... not sure what you call it but its basically an adapter that lets you place front panel pins into it while it is off the board, rather than fight with limited space. Sounds like they just went super cheap after makind good motherboards for several years.
